name: react-supabase-fullstack
description: Full-Stack React + Supabase application scaffold adhering to modular enterprise architecture

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
